title: Yahweh acknowledges the gods of Egypt in Exodus
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Yahweh acknowledges the gods of Egypt in Exodus, about Exodus era at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the Hebrew God, Yahweh, recognizes and acknowledges the existence of the gods of Egypt. in in Exodus, he tells Moses that he's going to execute his I think it's Exodus 12, he tells him that he's going to execute his wrath on the gods of Egypt.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns points to the Book of Exodus in the Bible, around chapter 12, where the Hebrew God, Yahweh, tells Moses he will bring his wrath down on the gods of Egypt. Caverns says this shows Yahweh recognising that those gods exist. If read that way, it would mean the old texts treated Egypt's gods as real beings.
